messages.author: 065110cca96a6373
messages.subject: suppress empty plot from par()
parts:
Hi,

I am using the lovely knitr package for some webpages at my
school/job, and I am stuck trying to figure out how to suppress an
empty plot. Often I can get around those by setting fig.keep="last",
but here I cannot because I am actually creating several plots. Here
is the webpage:

http://www.ats.ucla.edu/stat/r/pages/looping_strings.htm

and here is the source code:

http://www.ats.ucla.edu/stat/r/pages/looping_strings_source.html

(normally just the filename.Rhtml, but I do not have permission to set
the server mime types and it will not serve .Rhtml files by default).

Any ideas either for changing how I use knitr or R?

Thanks!

Josh

P.S. Bit by bit I am migrating many of the old ATS R webpages to use
knitr and all here (http://www.ats.ucla.edu/stat/R/code_fragments.htm)
do.


--
Joshua Wiley

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] suppress empty plot from par()
parts:
One possible solution: do not put par() in the code; use a chunk hook
instead, e.g.

knit_hooks$set(pars = function(before, options, envir) {
if (before) do.call('par', options$pars)
})

<<pars = list(las = 1, bty = 'l')>>=
plot(1:10, 1:10)
@

One thing that those who use R-devel can help -- I need the results of
the code below:

library(evaluate)
res = evaluate('par(las=1,bty="l")
plot(1:10,1:10)')
str(res, 3)

Under R 2.15.0, it is like this:

List of 3
$ :List of 1
..$ src: chr "par(las=1,bty=\"l\")\n"
..- attr(*, "class")= chr "source"
$ :List of 1
..$ src: chr "plot(1:10,1:10)"
..- attr(*, "class")= chr "source"
$ :List of 2
..$ :Dotted pair list of 7
.. ..$ :Dotted pair list of 2
.. ..$ :Dotted pair list of 2
.. ..$ :Dotted pair list of 2
.. ..$ :Dotted pair list of 2
.. ..$ :Dotted pair list of 2
.. ..$ :Dotted pair list of 2
.. ..$ :Dotted pair list of 2
..$ : raw [1:3864] 00 00 00 00 ...
..- attr(*, "version")= chr "2.15.0"
..- attr(*, "class")= chr "recordedplot"

Regards,
Yihui
--

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] suppress empty plot from par()
parts:
That is indeed what I hope users can do, but it is not rare to see
people using R released two years ago, and sometimes I see developers
are concerned about dependency on higher versions of R as well (e.g.
https://github.com/klutometis/roxygen/issues/71).

Anyway, this specific issue should not involve too many changes;
hopefully it will be easy to sort out. Perhaps after R 2.17 I will
drop this support for 2.15.

Regards,
Yihui
--
